content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text evaluates the Acts 2:30 link by the absence of an explicit naming of whose body is the channel, rather than by weighing the competing chains' footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "The phrase is 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse.'
